request.story_prompt: A young girl named Emma discovers an old time machine in an abandoned laboratory. She accidentally travels 100 years into the future and finds a city in danger. Emma must solve a mysterious puzzle, save the city, and return home before the time machine disappears forever.

panels.title: The Discovery
panels.scene_description: Alex, a young girl with messy hair and a worn backpack, pushes through dense vines in an enchanted forest to find a glowing, steampunk-style time machine half-buried in moss.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book style, vibrant colors, Alex with brown hair and a green utility vest standing in a lush magical forest, glowing brass time machine partially covered in ivy, cinematic lighting.

panels.title: The Leap Forward
panels.scene_description: Alex accidentally triggers a lever inside the machine, causing a swirl of neon light to envelop her, transporting her instantly to a futuristic, crumbling city with flying structures.
panels.image_prompt: Action shot, Alex inside the time machine cockpit, swirling vortex of blue and purple energy, background transitioning from forest to a dystopian futuristic city, dynamic perspective.

panels.title: The City in Peril
panels.scene_description: Alex stands on a high ledge overlooking a city where gravity-defying towers are flickering and collapsing. She spots a glowing, complex puzzle mechanism on a nearby pedestal.
panels.image_prompt: Wide shot, Alex looking at a futuristic city landscape with floating buildings, a glowing holographic puzzle pedestal in the foreground, comic book ink lines, atmospheric haze.

panels.title: Solving the Mystery
panels.scene_description: Alex intensely focuses on the puzzle, rotating crystalline nodes to align them. As she completes the pattern, a surge of golden light stabilizes the city structures.
panels.image_prompt: Close up of Alex's face showing determination, hands moving glowing crystalline shapes on a tech interface, golden light radiating from the puzzle, dramatic shadows.

panels.title: The Return
panels.scene_description: The time machine begins to fade away. Alex leaps back into the pilot seat just as the machine vanishes, returning her to the serene enchanted forest, leaving only a faint shimmer behind.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book panel, Alex sitting in the fading time machine, forest environment returning to focus, magical sparkles, sense of relief on Alex's face, high contrast colors.
